title: Numbers Bible Quiz - Chapter 7
description: Ten questions on Numbers 7: the wagons and oxen given to the Levites and the offerings of the twelve princes for the dedication of the altar.

questions.text: What did the princes of Israel first bring before the tabernacle as their offering?
questions.explanation: The princes brought six covered wagons and twelve oxen, a wagon for every two princes and an ox for each one.

answers.text: Six covered wagons and twelve oxen

questions.text: To whom did Moses give four wagons and eight oxen?
questions.explanation: Moses gave four wagons and eight oxen to the sons of Merari, according to their service, under the direction of Ithamar.

questions.text: Why did the sons of Kohath receive no wagons?
questions.explanation: The sons of Kohath received none, because the service of the sanctuary belonged to them and they carried it on their shoulders.

answers.text: They had already received carts from Aaron
They stayed behind at the camp
They carried the sanctuary on their shoulders
They refused the offering of the princes

questions.text: Who offered his offering on the first day?
questions.explanation: On the first day the offering was given by Nahshon the son of Amminadab, of the tribe of Judah.

questions.text: How much did each silver platter given by the princes weigh?
questions.explanation: Each prince gave one silver platter weighing one hundred thirty shekels, and one silver bowl of seventy shekels.

questions.text: What was each golden ladle full of?
questions.explanation: Each prince gave one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense.

questions.text: On which day did Elishama the son of Ammihud, prince of Ephraim, give his offering?
questions.explanation: On the seventh day Elishama the son of Ammihud, prince of the children of Ephraim, gave his offering.

questions.text: Ahira the son of Enan, who offered on the twelfth day, was prince of which tribe?
questions.explanation: On the twelfth day Ahira the son of Enan, prince of the children of Naphtali, gave his offering.

questions.text: What was the total weight of all the silver of the vessels given by the princes?
questions.explanation: All the silver of the vessels came to two thousand four hundred shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary.

questions.text: From where did Moses hear Yahweh's voice speaking to him in the Tent of Meeting?
questions.explanation: Moses heard the voice speaking to him from above the mercy seat on the ark of the Testimony, from between the two cherubim.

answers.text: From the pillar of cloud at the door
From the altar of burnt offering
From above the mercy seat, between the two cherubim
